subject: Genetics
title: Who Owns Your DNA Data
description: A short lesson to help you apply Who Owns Your DNA Data.

hook.text: 23andMe filed for bankruptcy in 2024 with 15 million customers' DNA data. Who owns that data now? Nobody's sure.

buildup.text: When you spit in a tube, you consent to terms of service.

discovery.text: GlaxoSmithKline paid 23andMe $300 million for access to customer DNA data in 2018. Your spit funded drug discovery.

twist.text: DNA data can't be changed like a password. A breach exposes your genetic identity permanently. There's no reset button.

climax.text: No federal U.S. law protects genetic data comprehensively.

punchline.text: Your DNA data is priceless. Your legal protections aren't.

quiz.question: What happened to 23andMe's DNA data when it filed for bankruptcy?
